hiding the capsule stops the foreground state and stopSelf(); configuration changes now restore the hidden/visible state instead of always showing it

the full load runs on the io executor and only re-renders when the signature changes

summary and first-run use COUNT(*) queries, and recoverExternalActions/reconcileActiveTasks moved off the main thread
